subject: Items
text: Items are used by pressing Start to open the menu, selecting ITEM, choosing the item with A, and pressing B outside menus.

evidence.quote:
1. Press Start to open the menu, then select ITEM.
2. Place the cursor next to the item you wish to use.
3. Press the A Button to select the item. Press A once more to set the item.
4. Exit all menus and press the B Button when you wish to use said item.

subject: Keys
text: Keys are used by equipping them and walking directly into the door to be opened.

evidence.quote: With Keys, just equip it and walk into the door you wish to open.

subject: Special Items
text: Most Special and Story items are automatically used when the time is right.

evidence.quote: Most Special/Story items will be automatically used when the time is right.

subject: Equipment
text: Equipment is equipped by pressing Start, selecting EQUIP, placing the cursor on the gear, and pressing A twice.

evidence.quote:
1. Press Start to open the menu, then select EQUIP.
2. Place the cursor next to the weapon/armor you wish to use.
3. Press the A Button to select the item. Press A once more to equip it.

subject: Armor and Weapons
text: Armor and weapons can only be changed if replacement armor or weapons are in inventory to switch with.

evidence.quote:
You can only change Armor/Weapons if you have Armor/Weapons to switch with
 (in other words, you always have to have some kind of Armor/Weapon
  equipped).
